system.description:
Translator Units cost 5000 credits and effectively considers the Intelligence of the Droid to be 4 higher for the purposes of understanding languages.

Assuming the Droid can speak, it also grants the ability to speak one other language (usually Basic, Huttese, or Ryl).

This item does stack with Linguist. Meaning Droids with Linguistics and intelligence score of 10 will often speak all three trade languages (Basic, Huttese, and Ryl).

Individual translation packs cost 50 credits (modified by rarity), must be installed one at a time taking one hour per language.
